content: The pass is blocked until day 5 (today is day 1). Pushing at the rocks is wasted time. Best plan: read the notice board (confirms schedule), then spend the days productively farming the meadow soil, and be ready at the pass on day 5 morning.

args.approach: Pass is blocked by rockslide until day 5 morning (wiki + notice board); instead of pushing rocks, read the notice, then till/plant/water parsnips in the south meadow to pass days 1-4, then walk to the pass gap (11,3) and up the east corridor to the chest at (11,1) on day 5.
